scope: Follow-up audit requested by owner: asynchronous context targeting, cancellation, source invalidation, queue errors and crop interactions

findings_fixed.finding: Opening another Explorer menu could cancel an outstanding source check without delivering its result, leaving a context operation busy
findings_fixed.correction: Filesystem photo requests have independent token keys within the existing bounded queue

findings_fixed.finding: Undo/Redo request rejected by a full service queue left the context batch active with no result pending
findings_fixed.correction: Report queue failure and finish the affected photo operation

findings_fixed.finding: Deferred navigation retained only a path, allowing a replacement photograph at that path to receive the requested view/crop action
findings_fixed.correction: Retain Item identity in PendingView and recheck id, path, digest and observation after navigation; terminal unavailability produces an explicit result

findings_fixed.finding: Navigation cancellation waited for source verification I/O to return, so an offline filesystem could keep the command busy
findings_fixed.correction: Revoke unsubmitted verification immediately; ignore its late result; accepted writes still finish on original targets

additional_corrections: Source monitor updates photographs retained outside the current folder
Undo/Redo disabled when none of the targets has applicable history
Unresolved photographs keep identity-dependent commands disabled until observation completes
Result instructions distinguish per-photo adjustment undo from annotation undo in the menu
Explicit crop-close prompt localized in Italian and English
Synthetic pressure tests use a separate manager so the live OS poll cannot overwrite injected pressure; production memory policy unchanged
